_comment: Supported/candidate USB IDs for consumer structured-light 3D scanners. Confirmed IDs come from dmesg/lsusb captures; unconfirmed IDs are shipped with "enabled": false so they are ignored until verified on real hardware. Omit productId (or set it to "*") to match every product from a vendor.

devices.label: Revopoint POP4 / POP / POP2 / POP3 / MINI / RANGE (Chishine3d ZXProduct, confirmed 2026-07-16)
Revopoint (any product on vendor 2207 — covers newer firmware/models)
Creality CR-Scan Otter (Orbbec module, confirmed via dmesg 2bc5:06da)
Creality CR-Scan Ferret / Ferret Pro / Raptor (any product on vendor 2bc5)
Einstar / Shining3D (UNCONFIRMED VID — run `lsusb` with the scanner attached, set the real idVendor here, then flip "enabled" to true)
